title: from_bdrhap_to_h5mu
description:
Convert the output of the BD Rhapsody Sequence Analysis pipeline to a MuData h5 file.

The gene ids (e.g. Ensembl ids) are used as `.var` index, the gene symbols are stored in `.var['gene_symbol']`
and the feature types in `.var['feature_types']`. For targeted assays and AbSeq, the gene id is equal to the
feature name. Only the putative cells are included in the 'rna' and 'prot' modalities.

The sample tag and sample name of each cell (when using sample multiplexing) are stored in `.obs['sample_tag']`
and `.obs['sample_name']`. The t-SNE and UMAP coordinates calculated by the BD Rhapsody pipeline are
stored in `.obsm['X_tsne_bd_rhapsody']` and `.obsm['X_umap_bd_rhapsody']`.

The TCR/BCR contigs are stored in the 'vdj_t', 'vdj_t_gd' and 'vdj_b' modalities, using the
scirpy data structure. These modalities contain all contigs for all cell labels, not only for
the putative cells. Whether a cell label is a putative cell is stored in the 'putative_cell'
column of '.obs'.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: The Cellismo (.cellismo) or MuData (.h5mu) file generated by the BD Rhapsody Sequence Analysis pipeline.

input_vdj_contigs.description:
The unfiltered VDJ contigs in AIRR format ('*_VDJ_Unfiltered_Contigs_AIRR.tsv.gz') generated by the
BD Rhapsody Sequence Analysis pipeline

output.help_text: Type: `file`, multiple: `False`, required, default: `"$id.$key.output.h5mu"`, direction: `output`, example: `"output.h5mu"`.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
